name: Trial of Fire
summary: The Trial of Fire is an arcane testing ground perched high in the cliffs of Azshara above the Arcane Pinnacle. Maintained by Archmage Xylem, this plateau challenges aspiring mages and daring adventurers to dodge deadly bursts of flame skipping between enchanted runes.

sections.title: A Crucible of Flame
sections.body: Perched on a high ridge overlooking Azshara, the Trial of Fire is one of the specialized gauntlets devised by Archmage Xylem to test the reflexes, focus, and magical fortitude of his pupils. The platform is marked by an intricate ring of runic circles that erupt periodically with violent bursts of fire. As each rune detonates, streaks of magical flame shoot toward neighboring seals, chaining the devastation across the stone floor. Challengers must constantly read the flow of energy and dance between the safe spots to prove their mastery before the watchful eyes of Xylem's magical projections.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Trial of Fire?
aliases: why does trial of fire exist
faq.answer: It serves as a proving ground devised by Archmage Xylem to test the coordination and awareness of his apprentices. Surviving the trial requires reading the flow of arcane energy between the runes and avoiding the shifting flame bursts.

faq.q: How do you reach this platform?
aliases: how to get to trial of fire
faq.answer: The platform sits high above the ground and is traditionally reached via magical teleportation using a designated fire stone located at Archmage Xylem's Arcane Pinnacle.

aliases: who is at trial of fire
faq.answer: An illusory Image of Archmage Xylem monitors the area alongside Darwin, an apprentice struggling to master the swift steps required to endure the flames.

angles.text: Xylem's trials represent an eccentric, perilous branch of Kirin Tor training, testing whether a caster's feet and focus are as sharp as their spellcasting.
